speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development for FY2021 and FY2022 respectively (a) what is the total number of (i) group 2 cases, (ii) group 3 cases and (iii) group 4 cases that are handled by the Family Service Centres (FSCs); and (b) what is the total number of social workers employed by the FSCs.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I think that looking at the data that was presented, it looks like there is an increasing number of caseloads, but a similar number of social workers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I ask the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) whether they feel that there are sufficient social workers at this point, and if there is a shortfall, what are the plans to increase the number of social workers?

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: If you compare these two years, actually, there was a decrease.
